fields.minimum: Original numeric-value/name table including unlabeled/nodata/ignore; water/forest entries and source dictionary version.
Existing definitions/CLC correspondence and stated mixture/cover/height or watercourse/inland/coastal distinctions; unknown if unspecified.
fields.required_for: annotation-defined task, not exact physical/species equivalence

fields.minimum: EO1 scene IDs/dates, radiometric stage/units/scale/offset/nodata, atmospheric/geometric/resampling notes,176 retained original IDs/numbering/wavelengths where available.
Existing public footprints or CRS/transform/overlap statement plus aggregate original polygon/group counts by scene/class. No private geometry or parcel list at this stage.
fields.required_for: geometry feasibility; no automatic independence certificate

fields.purpose: Check K5/V5 feasibility before selecting any point
fields.minimum: Aggregate annotated pixels and original groups for water and three forest labels in each public training scene; absent/unknown explicit.
fields.required_for: class/role feasibility, not target model selection

fields.minimum: Public-training product confirmation, exact-version license/attribution/revision and assembly/annotation history available to maintainers. No certification of third-party checkpoint histories.
